visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle CSS noise overlays or dot grids on the right sandbox pane to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for glassmorphism. Avoid heavy drop shadows, use inner-strokes.

component_guidelines.cards: Flat solid surfaces using bg-[#2D3748] with border-[#4A5568]. Inside padding must be generous (p-6 or p-8). Hover state adds a subtle border glow (border-[#48BB78]/50).
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp-edged or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary buttons: bg-[#48BB78] text-[#1A202C] font-bold. Hover: bg-[#38A169] text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(72,187,120,0.4)].
component_guidelines.tabs: Underline minimalist style or pill-based. Active tab should have text-[#48BB78] and a visible indicator (like Framer Motion underline).
component_guidelines.chat_widget: Floating crystal glass variant. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1A202C]/85 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl. User bubbles: bg-[#48BB78] text-[#1A202C]. AI bubbles: bg-[#2D3748] text-white.
component_guidelines.color_picker: Hide native input. Use custom styled circular swatches. Active state gets ring-2 ring-[#48BB78] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#1A202C].
component_guidelines.calendar: Shadcn calendar styled for dark mode. #48BB78 for selected dates, dark gray hover states. Remove outer borders for a seamless look.

grids.dashboard: Split-screen architecture. Left Pane (Config): w-full lg:w-[45%] lg:max-w-xl overflow-y-auto px-6 py-8 md:px-12 md:py-12. Right Pane (Sandbox): hidden lg:flex lg:flex-1 h-screen sticky top-0 bg-[#0D1117] relative items-center justify-center.
grids.landing_page: Bento Grid ('Tetris' Mode). Asymmetric layouts mixing col-span-4 and col-span-8. Generous padding (py-24 to py-32).
grids.spacing: Gap-8 to gap-12 between major sections. Inner card padding p-6 or p-8.

layouts.sandbox_preview: The right pane should look like a mock website. Add a fake header and hero, with the AI Chat Widget fixed to the bottom right of this specific container (absolute positioning relative to the right pane).
layouts.admin_panel: Dense data table layout. Avoid bulky cards. Use border-collapse styling with a single 1px bottom border per row.

motion.hover_states: Buttons scale up slightly (scale-[1.02]) with a 0.2s ease-out transform.
motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up (translate-y-4 to translate-y-0) staggered on children.
motion.widget_preview: Animate chat bubbles popping in with framer-motion (spring physics: stiffness 400, damping 25).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-secondary (#A0AEC0) against #1A202C passes WCAG AA. Primary text (#FFFFFF) is AAA.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap all animations with prefers-reduced-motion media query checks.

image_urls.description: Professional portrait for the live AI video widget playing in the chat.
E-commerce product shown inside the chat widget simulation.
Abstract futuristic dark/neon tech pattern for landing page.
Sponsor/Partner logo for trust band on the landing page.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for UI physics. For the Sandbox background, implement a subtle CSS-based dot matrix or TSParticles (network mesh) to feel like an active AI zone.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The project uses `.js` (JSX) files, NOT `.tsx`. Do not use TypeScript syntax.
Always use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for Headings and 'Satoshi' for Body. Import them via Google Fonts or Fontshare in index.css.
Implement the Dashboard using a strict two-pane layout where the right side (Sandbox) is visually distinct with a darker #0D1117 background.
The AI Widget inside the Sandbox must feature a 'Live Video' container at the top (using the Avatar placeholder image) with a pulsing #48BB78 status dot.
Knowledge Ingestion tab requires a drag-and-drop zone styled with dashed borders and hover tint.
Widget Branding tab must include at least 3 custom color pickers.
Operational Matrix tab must contain a functional-looking calendar (Shadcn style) for booking slots.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Keep surfaces solid with sharp 1px borders.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
NEVER use placeholder text for logos or images. Use the provided image URLs.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in headers or overlays where content scrolls under. Use solid colors or backdrop blurs.
Always apply GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.
